instruction: Convert all single-character variable names to descriptive names: 'n' to 'length', 'j' to 'pass_num', 'i' to 'index'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires variable renaming. Verifies descriptive variable names are present.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly checks both presence of new variable names ('length', 'pass_num', 'index') AND absence of old names ('n', 'j', 'i')
Robust implementation: Uses AST parsing to extract actual variable names from Python code, ensuring context-aware verification (not just string matching)
Fallback mechanism: If AST parsing fails, falls back to regex with word boundaries to avoid false positives from substrings
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses expected.get('contains', []) without the common error pattern of accessing expected.get('rules', {})
Proper state extraction: Getter retrieves file content via get_vm_file, and postconfig saves the file before evaluation
Logic correctness: The metric returns 0.0 if any old variable name is still present OR if any new variable name is missing, and 1.0 only when conversion is complete
